prose: Reuters reports from Anthropic's IPO prospectus that Broadcom agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion through a convertible note, which could help finance Anthropic's $125.2 billion, five-year TPU lease commitment. Broadcom stands out among the big-tech partnerships the prospectus documents. Based on the Techmeme excerpt.
highlights: Broadcom to lend up to $42B via convertible note
Could help fund a $125.2B, five-year TPU lease
